headline: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 reaches 20.24% matched code
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 rises from 19.79% to 20.24% matched code, with 2,834 of 5,109 functions in the project's progress report. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. A batch of 36 implementations adapted from the US decompilation lands in #24, alongside more small functions and an Umbris routine.
highlights: The imported functions are paired with PAL counterparts and use PAL data and helper addresses (#24).
The README gains clearer explanations of the project, contributing and licensing (#25).
